title: On the Definition of Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2507.22423v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: To engineer AGI, we should first capture the essence of intelligence in a species-agnostic form that can be evaluated, while being sufficiently general to encompass diverse paradigms of intelligent behavior, including reinforcement learning, generative models, classification, analogical reasoning, and goal-directed decision-making. We propose a general criterion based on \textit{entity fidelity}: Intelligence is the ability, given entities exemplifying a concept, to generate entities exemplifying the same concept. We formalise this intuition as \(\varepsilon\)-concept intelligence: it is \(\varepsilon\)-intelligent with respect to a concept if no chosen admissible distinguisher can separate generated entities from original entities beyond tolerance \(\varepsilon\). We present the formal framework, outline empirical protocols, and discuss implications for evaluation, safety, and generalization.

translated_abstract: 为工程化通用人工智能（AGI），我们应首先以物种无关的形式捕捉智能的本质，使其既可评估，又足够通用，以涵盖各种智能行为范式，包括强化学习、生成模型、分类、类比推理和目标导向决策。我们提出一个基于“实体保真度”的通用准则：智能是给定体现某一概念的实体，生成体现同一概念的实体的能力。我们将这一直觉形式化为\(\varepsilon\)-概念智能：如果没有任何选定的可接受区分器能将生成的实体与原始实体区分到超过容差\(\varepsilon\)的程度，则该系统相对于该概念是\(\varepsilon\)-智能的。我们提出了正式框架，概述了实证协议，并讨论了其对评估、安全性和泛化的影响。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于实体保真度的通用智能定义，即智能是生成与给定概念实体不可区分的实体的能力，并形式化为\(\varepsilon\)-概念智能，为AGI评估提供了统一标准。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a general definition of intelligence based on entity fidelity, formalized as \(\varepsilon\)-concept intelligence, where intelligence is the ability to generate entities indistinguishable from those of a given concept, offering a unified criterion for AGI evaluation.
